method: 10 interleaved HEAD/new pairs per query; each pair contains runs=11 and runs=0 fresh processes, alternating both variant and run-count order. Each process has one exact warm execution. Adjusted event count per query = (runs11 - runs0)/11, removing input, exact warm execution and publication overhead shared by the two processes. perf stat -r 1 is invoked ten times rather than one -r 10 invocation to interleave variants. Both raw and adjusted values retained.
hot_path_finding: Retired instructions are not equal: this is not explained by seed/layout variance alone. Both queries retain the same numeric valuation keys and dedup insert machine instructions (apart from relocations). The GROUP accumulator RandomState::hash_one::<&(&i64,)> changes from a register-only specialized SipHash body to an 88-byte stack frame plus an outlined Sip13Rounds::write call; H18 group-table reserve_rehash also calls that helper instead of its previous inlined hash. No hasher algorithm or key type changed, but rustc/LLVM generated extra machine instructions.
